donation.uploadSubtitle: we will fill in the details
donation.guidanceBody: Take a clear photo with the full food item visible. Keep the main item centered, use good lighting, avoid blur, and make sure the food is fully inside the frame. AI suggestions may be wrong, so please review and edit before posting.

guidancePoints.fullItem: Show the full food item clearly inside the frame.
guidancePoints.centered: Keep the main item centered and easy to identify.
guidancePoints.lighting: Use good lighting and avoid blur or heavy shadows.
guidancePoints.quantityCue: If you know the amount, add cues like small, medium, large, heavy, or extra heavy when editing.

donation.quantityHint: If helpful, describe size or weight with cues like small, medium, large, heavy, or extra heavy.

errors.quantity: Please enter a valid quantity (must be greater than 0)
errors.aiTimeout: AI recognition failed or timed out. You can still manually enter the food details.
errors.deleteFailed: Could not remove this listing. Please try again.

donation.reviewNotice: AI suggestions can be inaccurate. Please double-check the food name, quantity, and category before posting.
